debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-t-a-g-e-d t-h-e w-o-r-k-i-n-j-u-r-y, l-e-f-t a f-a-l-s-e i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t r-e-p-o-r-t a-s t-h-e a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-o-a-c-h-e-d t-h-e c-o-w-o-r-k-e-r a-n-d d-o-c-t-o-r, l-e-f-t m-e-t-a c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n t-r-a-c-e-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t c-o-n-f-i-r-m-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-l-t-e-r-e-d t-h-e m-e-d-i-c-a-l r-e-c-o-r-d-s, l-e-f-t d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y s-a-m-p-l-i-n-g p-r-o-c-e-s-s.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r p-r-e-p-a-r-e-d t-h-e c-l-a-i-m f-o-r i-n-s-u-r-e-r r-e-v-i-e-w, l-e-f-t s-u-b-m-i-t-t-e-d c-l-a-i-m f-i-l-e-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e f-a-c-t u-n-d-e-r-l-y-i-n-g c-o-r-r-o-b-o-r-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r t-r-i-e-d t-o d-e-c-e-i-v-e t-h-e i-n-v-e-s-t-i-g-a-t-i-o-n, l-e-f-t f-o-r-g-e-d w-e-a-k-n-e-s-s e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e v-a-l-i-d-i-t-y a-s-s-e-s-s-m-e-n-t.
